html_source: The Shot at Dawn Memorial in the National Memorial Arboretum near Alrewas, Staffordshire, which commemorates the 346 British and Commonwealth soldiers executed for desertion in WWI after courts-martial (untold others were simply dispatched behind the lines by their officers). The statue was modeled on 17-year-old Private Herbert Burden. Source: Wikimedia Commons.

The Shot at Dawn Memorial in the National
  Memorial Arboretum near Alrewas, Staffordshire, which
  commemorates the 346 British and Commonwealth soldiers executed
  for desertion in WWI after courts-martial (untold others were
  simply dispatched behind the lines by their officers). The
  statue was modeled on 17-year-old Private Herbert Burden.
  Source: Wikimedia Commons.
